servicesPage.intro: At JP Auto Service, we offer a full range of auto repair and maintenance services to keep your vehicle running smoothly. From oil changes to engine overhauls, our certified technicians have the skills and equipment to handle any job.

services.title: Oil Change & Fluid Services
services.shortDescription: Keep your engine running smoothly with regular oil changes and fluid checks.
services.longDescription: Regular oil changes are the most important maintenance task for your vehicle. We use high-quality oils and filters to protect your engine, improve fuel economy, and extend engine life. Our fluid services include transmission, brake, coolant, and power steering fluid exchanges to ensure all systems operate at peak performance.
benefits: Extends engine life and improves performance
Prevents costly repairs down the road

process.title: Inspection
process.description: We check your current oil level, condition, and all fluid reservoirs.

process.title: Drain & Replace
process.description: Old oil is drained, filter replaced, and fresh oil is added to manufacturer specifications.

process.title: Final Check
process.description: We verify no leaks, reset your oil life monitor, and provide a sticker for your next service.

faqs.question: How often should I get an oil change?
faqs.answer: Most modern vehicles need an oil change every 5,000 to 7,500 miles. Check your owner's manual for specific recommendations.

faqs.question: What type of oil do you use?
faqs.answer: We use conventional, synthetic blend, and full synthetic oils from top brands to match your vehicle's requirements.

services.title: Brake Repair & Replacement
services.shortDescription: Restore stopping power with professional brake services.
services.longDescription: Your brakes are your vehicle's most critical safety system. Our brake services include inspection, pad and rotor replacement, caliper repair, and brake fluid flush. We use premium parts to ensure quiet, confident stopping and long-lasting performance. Signs you need brake service: squealing, grinding, vibration, or a soft pedal.
benefits: Prevents damage to rotors and calipers

process.title: Brake Inspection
process.description: We measure pad thickness, rotor condition, and check calipers, lines, and fluid.

process.title: Component Replacement
process.description: Worn pads and rotors are replaced with high-quality OEM or equivalent parts.

process.title: Test Drive & Adjustment
process.description: We test the brakes on the road and make final adjustments for optimal performance.

faqs.question: How long do brake pads last?
faqs.answer: Typically 30,000 to 70,000 miles depending on driving habits and conditions.

faqs.question: Why are my brakes squeaking?
faqs.answer: Squeaking often indicates worn pads or dust between components. We can diagnose and fix the issue quickly.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics & Repair
services.shortDescription: Advanced diagnostics to pinpoint and fix engine issues.
services.longDescription: When your check engine light comes on or your car isn't performing as it should, our advanced diagnostic equipment quickly identifies the root cause. We then provide a clear explanation and repair options. From sensor replacements to major engine work, our technicians are equipped to handle all makes and models.
benefits: Accurate diagnosis saves time and money
Prevents minor issues from becoming major

process.title: Scan & Analyze
process.description: We connect a professional scanner to read trouble codes and live data.

process.title: In-Depth Testing
process.description: Further tests like compression, vacuum, and fuel pressure pinpoint the issue.

process.title: Repair & Verify
process.description: We perform the necessary repair and test drive to ensure the problem is resolved.

faqs.question: What does the check engine light mean?
faqs.answer: It can indicate anything from a loose gas cap to a serious engine problem. We'll diagnose it accurately.

faqs.question: Can you fix check engine light issues same day?
faqs.answer: Many issues can be fixed same day. We'll let you know the scope of work after diagnosis.

services.title: Tire Services & Alignment
services.shortDescription: Maximize tire life and handling with expert tire care.
services.longDescription: Proper tire maintenance is essential for safety, fuel economy, and ride comfort. We offer tire rotation, balancing, new tire installation, and precision wheel alignment. Our state-of-the-art alignment equipment ensures your vehicle tracks straight and tires wear evenly. We also provide flat repair and tire pressure checks.
benefits: Longer tire life and even wear

process.title: Tire Inspection
process.description: We check tread depth, pressure, and overall condition of all tires.

process.title: Rotation & Balancing
process.description: Tires are rotated according to manufacturer pattern and balanced to eliminate vibration.

process.title: Alignment Check
process.description: Using precision equipment, we adjust camber, caster, and toe to factory specs.

faqs.question: How often should I rotate my tires?
faqs.answer: Every 5,000 to 7,500 miles, or as recommended in your owner's manual.

faqs.question: Do I need an alignment if I hit a pothole?
faqs.answer: Yes, potholes can knock your alignment out of spec. Signs include pulling to one side or uneven tire wear.

about.headline: Your Trusted Local Auto Repair Shop in Dallas
about.mission: To provide honest, high-quality auto repair services that keep our community safe on the road.
story: JP Auto Service was founded with a simple mission: deliver expert auto repair with integrity. Our founder, a lifelong mechanic, saw too many customers overcharged for unnecessary work. He built JP Auto on transparency, fair pricing, and technical excellence. Today, we serve Dallas drivers from our Rowan Avenue shop, treating every car as if it were our own.

Over the years, we've grown from a small two-bay garage to a full-service shop equipped with the latest diagnostic tools. But our core values remain unchanged. We invest in our team's training, use quality parts, and take the time to educate our customers. Whether it's a simple oil change or a complex engine repair, you can count on JP Auto Service for reliable, honest work.
